name: Electric Type / independent screen
rationale: Original Signal House cinema deck inspired by the Electric Type saved pin's expressive yellow lettering and sweeping leader geometry in the verified 2026-09-27 snapshot. Pinterest was inaccessible on 2026-11-09; no new observation is claimed. Deep blue stages, warm projector type and coral leader edges organize compact numbered navigation, a split condensed/italic hero with vertical metric rail, horizontal roadmap chapters, broad resource rows, three-column film shelves and a two-voice logbook. Original responsive CSS with existing licensed fonts and SVG only; enjoyment-first films, private poster palettes and themed scrollbars are preserved. No copied artwork or logos.
